sources.title: Current leadership biography
sources.findings: President, CEO and director; from Trivandrum, lives Memphis; chemical engineering bachelor at IIT and master at Syracuse, MBA at UT Austin.
sources.caution: No specific IIT campus, graduation dates or citizenship inferred; director is not chairman.

sources.title: 2026 Form 10-K: executive biography and one FedEx
sources.findings: 1991 career start; January 2017 marketing chief; March 2019 president/COO; January 2020 director; June 2022 CEO. Ground and Services merged into Federal Express on June 1, 2024.
sources.caution: Read executive table, merger and risk paragraphs only. Age 60 as of July 20, 2026 conflicts with secondary 1967 birth; leave birth unknown. Legal merger does not prove all network integration complete.

sources.title: 2022 Form 8-K/A: CEO succession confirmation
sources.findings: Confirms appointment as president and CEO effective June 1, 2022, succeeding founder Frederick W. Smith.
sources.caution: March announcement and CEO-elect period are not effective CEO date; not founder or board chairman.

sources.title: June 1, 2026: Freight spin-off completed
sources.findings: Freight independent publicly traded company; distribution of 80.1% of shares, FedEx retained 19.9% at separation.
sources.caution: Distribution to shareholders, not sale of entire group or claim Raj leads independent Freight. Prospective disposal of retained stake not stated completed.

sources.title: October 28, 2026: third-quarter results
sources.findings: Attributed CEO remarks on network and costs; October 1 sale of FedEx Supply Chain to CMA CGM completed.
sources.caution: Read opening, remarks and transaction section, not full tables. Quarter is calendar Q3; forecasts not achievements and remarks do not establish physical attendance.

sources.title: October 28, 2026: CEO certification
sources.findings: Signed /s/ Rajesh Subramaniam as president and CEO for quarter ended September 30.
sources.caution: Documentary recent activity, not independent observation of a public appearance.

sources.title: Raj Subramaniam: conflicting birth entry
sources.caution: Secondary date conflicts with primary annual-report age; not adopted, and no replacement birth year inferred from age.
